what: Top-level declarations that no export of their own module can reach. Measured by scripts/quality/export-reachability.mjs over src/app and src/components. Every entry below was verified by counting occurrences of the name in its own file: the declaration is the only occurrence, so nothing in the module refers to it.
rules: A NEW finding fails the check. Mount it, export it, delete it, or add it here with a reason.

A finding recorded here that is no longer unreachable ALSO fails the check. An exemption that outlives its defect protects nothing and hides the next one, so a cleanup must delete its line in the same change.

Nothing here is scheduled for deletion by this file. U-504 excludes deleting what the census finds: each removal is its own bounded item with its own unreachability proof, because a deletion justified only by a bulk report is how a live surface gets removed.
